rationale: The agent identified the user and the correct order and successfully initiated a return, providing seemingly accurate refund details. However, it performed an order-changing write (return submission) without first confirming with the user, which violates the stated policy to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Authentication was minimal (name and ZIP) but the critical failure is lack of explicit confirmation prior to submitting the return. Therefore, despite completing the request, it did not do so in line with the policy.
